properties.name: polystore.containers
properties.description: Storage containers created at startup; the entry marked default=true answers StorageManager#getDefaultContainer.

properties.name: polystore.containers[0].name
properties.description: Unique container name used with StorageManager#getContainer.

properties.name: polystore.containers[0].type
properties.description: StorageProvider type identifier (e.g. local, minio, s3); also names the sibling key holding provider-specific parameters, e.g. polystore.containers[0].minio.endpoint.

properties.name: polystore.containers[0].default
properties.description: Marks this container as the default one; at most one container may be marked.

properties.name: polystore.containers[0].tenant-isolation
properties.description: Tenant isolation mode; PATH_PREFIX transparently prefixes every file path with the resolved tenant id.

values.description: All tenants share the same path space (default).
Every file path is transparently prefixed with {tenantId}/.
